shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum exhibit slight daily gains after recent volatility.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index currently sits at 23, reflecting extreme fear among investors.
The Federal Reserve's signals of potential interest rate hikes continue to pressure risky crypto assets.
US-Iran tensions are escalating, with Iran threatening to close the Strait of Hormuz.
The EU plans to ban privacy coins and anonymous crypto accounts starting July 2027.
